jei.jaymospowers.sleeping_bag: Sleeps one out in the open. It never sets your spawn.
jei.jaymospowers.hammock: Needs an anchor (a log, fence, wall or any solid face) one block past each end. Sleeping in it passes the night but never sets your spawn.
jei.jaymospowers.paraglider: Held open in a fall it slows you and carries you forward on the air.
jei.jaymospowers.hot_air_balloon: Feed the burner coal, logs, planks or sticks. Jump to burn and rise, the back key to vent and sink. It cannot be steered: the wind blows a different way at every height, so climb or sink until you find a layer that goes your way. Hit it to take it back.
jei.jaymospowers.river_ice: In the cold, rivers freeze from their banks, and floes break off and drift downstream with whatever stands on them. They thaw when it warms. Breaking out the bank of a small lake can also let a flood run downhill.
jei.jaymospowers.vein_rumour: Village masons sell rumours of ore veins: a paper that names the metal, the way and the rough distance, or for more a map with the place marked.

jei.jaymospowers.dogs_learn: A tamed wolf learns from what it does with you. After 10 animals killed it becomes a Hunter and bites harder; after 25, a Tracker that follows a wounded beast's blood trail. After 10 monsters killed it becomes a Guard, tougher with a thicker coat. After 2,000 blocks walked at your side it becomes a Pack Dog that carries 9 slots. After 20 minutes among farm animals it becomes a Herder: sneak near it and the animals around it walk to you. Sneak and use your dog with an empty hand to hear what it knows and open its pack.
jei.jaymospowers.smell: Unwashed days, sweat from sprinting and grime on your armour make you smell. Beasts and monsters smell you from further away, people a little, and villagers say so. Water washes it off: at once under water, slowly when wading or in the rain. Sneak and use a water cauldron with an empty hand (a wash tub, or a bath house) to scrub most of it off for one level of water.
